court: High Court of Judicature at Madras
trial_court: Family Court, Krishnagiri (M.O.P.No.95 of 2022) and Sub Court, Sathyamangalam, Erode District (H.M.O.P.No.64 of 2022)
facts_of_case: Petitioner and respondent are living separately due to misunderstanding; petitioner seeks transfer of divorce case from Family Court, Krishnagiri to Sub Court, Sathyamangalam, Erode District.

legal_principles.principle: The domicile or citizenship of the opposite party is immaterial in a case like this.
legal_principles.held: In case the marriage was solemnized under Hindu Law marital relationship is governed by the provisions of the Hindu Marriage Act. Therefore, Section 19 has to be given a purposeful interpretation.

legal_principles.principle: The residence of the wife determines the question of jurisdiction.
legal_principles.held: It is the residence of the wife, which determines the question of jurisdiction, in case the proceeding was initiated at the instance of the wife.

legal_principles.principle: A beneficial provision meant for women should be given a meaningful interpretation.
legal_principles.held: Therefore such a beneficial provision meant for the women of our Country should be given a meaningful interpretation by this Court.

legal_principles.principle: The place of residence of the wife is the preferable place for conducting trial of matrimonial cases.
legal_principles.held: The place of wife is the preferable place for conducting trial of matrimonial cases and thus, the petition is to be considered.

outcome.final_order: Petition allowed and the case is transferred to the file of Sub Court, Sathyamangalam, Erode District.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: drafting a transfer petition for divorce proceedings
advising on jurisdictional issues in family courts
assisting with matrimonial disputes involving minor children
